summary: Example cards, so you can try the page before the first Friday run. Run /suggest-routines for real ones.

cards.title: SAP release-note watch
cards.what: Checks the BW/4HANA, Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud release notes and flags anything that changes how a client's reports work.
cards.evidence: 4 times (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri): "anything new in datasphere this week?"
cards.setup: Add a passive routine 'sap-release-watch' to os/routines/routines.json: weekly mon 08:00, haiku, low effort, tools Read + WebSearch + WebFetch, cap $1. Flag only notes that change BW/4HANA, Datasphere or SAC behaviour for a client in business/clients/.

cards.title: Friday timesheet draft
cards.what: Drafts the week's hours per client from the week's sessions and client notes, for you to check and send.
cards.evidence: 3 Fridays in a row: "help me fill in my hours for this week"
cards.setup: Add an active routine 'timesheet-friday' to os/routines/routines.json: weekly fri 16:00, haiku, low effort, tools Read + Glob + Bash(python3 os/recos/collect.py:*), cap $1. Output a table of hours per client and day.

cards.title: /proposal for SAP analytics offers
cards.what: Turns a client brief into a proposal in the youlytics format: scope, phases, days, price, risks.
cards.when: When a new lead comes in
cards.evidence: 3 times: "write a proposal for the SAC migration at ..."
cards.setup: Make a /proposal skill (sonnet) from business/offers/: it reads the brief, uses the latest proposal as the template, and writes to business/clients/<client>/proposal.md. Pin the brand from brand/brand-book.html for the PDF version.

cards.title: Invoices are in Dutch, emails in English
cards.what: You corrected the language of an invoice twice. Save it so it sticks.
cards.evidence: 2 corrections (Tue, Thu): "no, invoices in Dutch please"
cards.setup: Run /calibrate: invoices and anything for Belgian clients' finance teams are written in Dutch; emails and proposals in English unless the client writes in Dutch. Save to memory/ and link it from business/finance/.
